policy: Gate 1 must pass on an adapter before later gates run there. Screening is exploratory, not final research. Fresh systems/buffers use a tools-local same-device immutable pipeline cache keyed by full WGSL, entry and constants; cold misses and warm construction are recorded. Episode state is never pooled.

qualityGate.policy: Exploratory conservative acceptance bars registered before 2.1 runs. Each species must pass the same E/T/sigma setting. Failure blocks smoke learning and production, not a test pass disguised as statistical acceptance.

submission.compileCompletion: explicit async pipeline preparation; no simulation warm-up

scope: Staged subset spans both shapes/environments, a dense stress, a larger K, a replicated E and a matched contacts-off ablation. Larger frontier/1200-step settings are deferred if this subset supplies adequate evidence. No H1-H3 acceptance from smoke learning. Smoke settings are preregistered, not post-selected from favorable validation outcomes.
